subject: Joint sandbox cohort: OTLP bridge + Grafana observability flow
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@datadog.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: ivan.petros@grafana.com, observco-ops@observco.io
Date: 2027-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invitation: Joint Sandbox Cohort for OTLP bridge

Hi Laura / Ben —

Datadog Partnerships is putting together a small, focused sandbox cohort to validate an end-to-end OTLP bridge with two goals: (1) demonstrate seamless traces/metrics ingestion from customer agent -> Redwood -> Datadog, and (2) validate Grafana as the visualization layer on top of the same pipeline. We think Redwood's ability to host isolated sandboxes (Dedicated) makes this a great candidate.

High-level ask from our side:
- 1–2 dedicated sandboxes that can run a sample microservice workload for 2 weeks
- A technical kickoff next week to align on auth, SSO, and data retention constraints
- A short mutual action plan (MAP) we can track in HubSpot

I've attached the draft cohort invite (cohort-invite-v1.pdf) and a short intake form. Can you confirm interest and available kickoff windows? Also looping Ivan from Grafana to ensure they can join the cohort and validate dashboards.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

Sarah Kim
Partner Programs | Datadog

Attachments: cohort-invite-v1.pdf
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: sarah.kim@datadog.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, ivan.petros@grafana.com, observco-ops@observco.io
Date: 2027-09-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invitation: Joint Sandbox Cohort for OTLP bridge

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the invite — Redwood is interested. Short answers up front: yes, we can spin dedicated sandboxes (RDW Dedicated) for a 2-week cohort and we can provide sample workloads and a read-only access token for Datadog ingestion.

Proposed next steps:
- Please fill the quick intake doc: https://drive.google.com/rdw-intake/1a2b3c (I've pre-shared edit access)
- Technical kickoff: Tue 2027-09-21 or Wed 2027-09-22, 10–11am PT — does either work?
- Ben will draft a one-page MAP and a minimal onboarding checklist; Markus is looping to confirm any SLA/ops constraints.

Notes on gating items:
- SSO/whitelist: Datadog will need our outbound IP range for whitelist + we will need an SSO allowlist for Grafana to view private dashboards.
- Data retention: cohort telemetry will be ephemeral and auto-purged after 30 days unless otherwise requested.

I've attached a sandbox access stub (rdw-sandbox-access-stub.txt) with the credential flow we typically use. Ivan — if Grafana can confirm the expected dashboard templates you want to validate, we can seed them ahead of the kickoff.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
